signature_design_en: Short straight narrow tarnished silver dagger, small square blue-glass lamp integrated into the iron guard, midnight blue linen grip, tiny cool mist near the lamp only.
Broad dull copper leaf dagger with a chipped blunt spine, simple black leather handle, one red wax seal tied at the butt. Almost guardless, no jewel.
Slender gently curved dark violet steel ninja blade, flattened round iron guard, faded orange woven grip, single dim sunset reflection along lower edge.
Needle-like gray ninja blade with a hooked tip, very small oval guard, weathered charcoal braid, subtle smoke disappearing from the tip.
Broad pale silver straight military sword, squat rectangular brass crossguard with a stamped lion outline, dark red leather grip, blue wool tassel at pommel. Regal but minimally ornamented.

Narrow slightly curved leaf-shaped weathered pewter sword, short plain iron crossguard missing one upward quillon, faded moss-green cord grip, small slate pommel, loose faded green remembrance ribbon below guard.
visual_effect: pale green wisp only at lower blade

signature_design_en: Long heavy flat-ended sword with tapered corners, brushed pale steel broad blade, simple wide square copper guard, deep green cloth handle, a narrow red oath thread tied around the guard.
Monumental dark gray straight blade with a single off-center slot near base, inverted U-shaped small bronze guard suggesting an empty seat, brown leather grip and flat pommel.
Elegant slim silver katana with gentle curve, small crescent steel guard, blue-gray wrap, a faint white crescent mist at tip. No sheath.
Long matte black curved katana, tiny seven-notch plain iron disc guard, muted red winding, bare steel butt cap. No sheath.
Single broad moss-stained steel axe head with scalloped oak-leaf cutting profile, thick gnarled oak haft, bark collar and one loose dry leaf held by twine.
One squared heavy execution axe head of cold bluish iron, weathered pale ash haft, short black shackle bolted at butt, red cloth strip under head.
visual_effect: two dim red motes under head

signature_design_en: Patinated copper cruciform wind-key head with four vanes, key tooth, indigo wrapped short shaft.
Milky glass hexagonal lantern in worn blue iron cage on a short violet-wrapped shaft, pale linen knot.
One slim weathered olive-wood crook staff, curved top worn smooth, three small flat copper leaves fixed below crook, plain muted blue linen grip.
visual_effect: three faint warm motes near leaves

signature_design_en: One slender bent polished reddish yew-wood staff, organic asymmetric fork cradles a small pale pink river pebble tied with sage linen, short worn linen strip at upper shaft.
visual_effect: delicate pale rose wisp around fork

signature_design_en: One iron flail with a hollow green-patinated bronze bell as striking head, short visible straight chain and plain ash wood handle, bell has one long split.
visual_effect: small pale sound-ring close to bell

signature_design_en: One squat dark iron hourglass-shaped striking weight, short copper chain and black wrapped handle, severe functional silhouette. No glass hourglass.
Antique compact single-barrel signal pistol with long narrow gray barrel, red ceramic ignition chamber, aged pale wood grip and square iron sight. No modern components.
visual_effect: tiny fading orange spark at chamber

signature_design_en: Heavy short Goug hand cannon with stepped oxidized bronze barrel, offset small exposed gear at breech, muted teal grip and worn flat iron fittings.
Tall compact medieval crossbow, narrow pewter limbs, a tawny wooden stock with a simple slit sight framed by blue iron, one taut string. No loose bolt.
One small powerful recurve crossbow with dark plum wooden stock, broad unornamented pale iron limbs and short rectangular central mechanism, a faded red binding across the grip.
visual_effect: one dim crimson line at mechanism

signature_design_en: True longbow with a continuous gently recurved honey-colored wood limb, thin dull silver tips, orange woven grip and one taut gray string, no stock or crossbar.
visual_effect: tiny warm shimmer at upper tip

signature_design_en: True asymmetrical recurved longbow, pale gray bent wood upper limb longer than lower, indigo thread winds around middle and forms one taut string, red knot at lower tip. No stock, arrow or crossbar.
visual_effect: thin violet wisps along only a short string segment

signature_design_en: Compact ancient lyre built of dull gray stone-like wood, wide round base, squat curved arms, five bronze strings and a small ochre inset disk.
visual_effect: two soft dust-like motes at strings

signature_design_en: One small pear-shaped dark plum wood harp, low hooked upper arm, pale wood soundboard, fine silver strings, a single faded blue ribbon at base.
visual_effect: faint blue sound arc near strings

signature_design_en: Closed thick battered ochre parchment codex with charcoal cloth spine, asymmetrical bronze corner plates and a simple dark green leather buckle.
Closed small dusty blue cloth book with a blank torn circular parchment patch at center, worn gray iron clasp and one long red bookmark.
Full long spear with a narrow silver leaf blade and a short pale blue torn pennant directly below head, plain dark ash shaft, small iron butt. One weapon.
visual_effect: thin airy white wisp at head

signature_design_en: Full heavy dark iron lance with broad triangular head, two short squared side flanges below head like battlements, reddish wooden shaft and a gray cloth binding.
Full pale bamboo fighting pole with uneven joint segments, three narrow dark green binding bands and blunt gray iron caps, a tiny pale leaf tied near upper end.
Full charcoal lacquered fighting pole, three broad muted violet bands, one cracked pale ceramic collar near top and blunt ends.
visual_effect: small violet dust at cracked collar

signature_design_en: One squat rich brown leather satchel with a broad dull brass buckle shaped as two clasped hands, a faded orange fabric flap, patched corners and short handle.
One small soft ash-blue linen bag tied with plum cord, one empty open square iron clasp attached to flap, a torn white stitched patch and short carrying loop.
visual_effect: two soft silver motes at clasp

signature_design_en: One coherent folded ochre cloth with an angular blue woven border and an asymmetrical flowing corner, tactile heavy weave. No floating ornaments.
One long plum silk ribbon folded as an open spiral, pale gray frayed outer edge and one burgundy stitched seam, physically connected fabric.
visual_effect: thin pale lavender wisp at central fold

signature_design_en: Compact tall shield of overlapping slate-blue iron plates with a wide tan leather band across center, squared top and narrow rounded base, shallow blunt boss.
Asymmetric hexagonal ochre ceramic ward shield, indigo horizontal band, cast iron open-palm emblem, missing corner and repaired diagonal crack.
visual_effect: muted blue-gray circular distortion at palm

signature_design_en: One squat faded blue steel sallet with a short tan cloth neck guard and a closed narrow visor, low split comb reminiscent of a tower roof, no plume.
Closed angular muted-purple sallet helmet with continuous iron visor and two narrow eye slits, plain copper brow band and short backward white horsehair crest.
visual_effect: faint silver mist at crest base

signature_design_en: Low asymmetric sage-green folded silk coif, twin overlapping soft peaked folds, rust ribbon and a tiny dark blue stitched star-shaped patch.
palette: sage silk, rust ribbon, dark blue

signature_design_en: One deep red soft peaked hat with a rolled charcoal brim and a pale blue stitched crescent patch, the cone bends sideways rather than upward.
visual_effect: one tiny blue star mote beside patch

signature_design_en: One small bronze comb with three long ivory-colored bone teeth and a delicate faded blue woven flower fixed to one end, simple asymmetrical silhouette.
One bent silver hairpin with a single broad plum fabric knot, short pale linen ends, a small empty iron loop hanging directly from pin.
visual_effect: tiny white mote at empty loop

signature_design_en: Compact heavy riveted armor of staggered terracotta-red iron plates over charcoal chainmail, mismatched angular battlement pauldrons, ash-gray steel edges and short faded burgundy waist cloth.
visual_effect: three tiny warm amber chest seams

signature_design_en: One smooth pale blue steel cuirass with a prominent dark indigo diagonal repaired crack, small rounded unadorned pauldrons, navy padded waist and one silver chain directly across chest.
One short ochre padded fighting tunic with dark brown leather shoulder straps, wide sage cloth sash, large angular front closure and asymmetric short sleeves. Empty unworn torso only.
One sleeveless slate-gray wool coat with a broad faded red turned-down collar, long split tails and two mismatched simple iron clasps, a pale mended seam over heart.
visual_effect: small rose light at mended seam

signature_design_en: Unworn long deep teal scholar robe with broad tan woven collar, layered cuffs, brown sash and three almost erased ash-gray star constellations on front and lower hem.
palette: deep teal, tan, ash gray, brown

signature_design_en: One unworn pale gray long hoodless robe with loose deep violet sleeves, charcoal cross-wrapped sash and an irregular red embroidered seam on one side.
One coherent pair of dark green soft leather boots with rolled tan tops, wide dull copper ankle buckles and lightly curled worn toes, no spikes or wings.
One coherent pair of ash-white wrapped walking boots with dark indigo soles, asymmetric plum ankle ties and plain weathered gray buckles.
visual_effect: small pale trailing mist at heels

signature_design_en: One coherent pair of short burnt-orange leather forearm bracers with overlapping gray iron fingerless wrist plates, thick dark straps and small pale seam.
One coherent pair of long dull blue steel vambraces, clean taper and single deep red cord around each wrist, flat black leather elbows, no jewel ornaments.
visual_effect: thin dim red reflection at wrist

signature_design_en: One thick hammered copper ring with flattened rectangular top stamped with a worn off-center gray spiral, green patina in grooves and no precious gemstone.
One uneven dark iron ring with a visibly severed small outer loop on one side and a tiny pale rose pearl mounted off-center, worn mauve thread wound around opposite side.
One broad woven dark blue wrist bracelet with alternating pale bone slats held in fabric, plain brown tie strings and no jewel.
One thick open ochre ceramic wrist cuff, asymmetrical broken-and-repaired crack fastened by three small iron staples, worn dark purple inner lining.
visual_effect: fine warm light only in crack

signature_design_en: One folded deep rust wool cloak with pale ash trim, low rounded collar and one plain oval dark iron clasp, wind-worn irregular hem.
One tapered deep indigo cape with muted teal inside lining, high folded shoulder collar, small tarnished silver pin shaped as a broken circle, short frayed edge.
visual_effect: short pale blue drifting wisp at hem

signature_design_en: One small squat amber glass perfume bottle, plain dark brown stopper wrapped in sage cord, two visible pale flower petals inside, minimal gray collar.
One small tall frosted violet glass scent bottle with uneven pear-shaped base, pale pewter stopper and a short faded red cloth tag tied to neck.
One four-point flat throwing star made of dull dark teal steel, deliberately broad blunt inner angles and narrow sharp tips, small central triangular opening.
visual_effect: tiny cool reflection at one tip

signature_design_en: Three swept-back leaf-shaped pewter blades around a small triangular iron hub; one short faded red oath knot attached to center.
Compact round charcoal ceramic hail grenade with thin dull pewter neck, dark blue short bent fuse, a few pale icy pellets and restrained frost on upper surface.
palette: charcoal ceramic, pewter, pale icy blue
visual_effect: localized frost and tiny hail pellets

signature_design_en: One pear-shaped pale gray clay bomb with a dark green wax sealed narrow neck, short bent brown fuse and irregular violet mineral crack across body.
One solid translucent pale amber tear crystal set in a small sage-green glazed ceramic three-leaf cup, suspended white pinpoint of light inside the crystal.
palette: pale amber crystal, sage ceramic, white

signature_design_en: One translucent pale-blue tear-shaped glass restorative flask, narrow gray metal neck, plum cord tied to a flat stopper, one white suspended bead inside.
